name: kube_bench
title: kube-bench
description: CIS Kubernetes Benchmark scanner — runs the master / etcd / controlplane / node / policies checks against the host where the executor runs. KUBEBENCH_BENCHMARK picks the benchmark version — valid values: cis-1.7 | cis-1.8 | eks-1.2.0 | gke-1.6.0 | aks-1.0 | rh-1.0 (see kube-bench docs for the full list). KUBEBENCH_TARGETS is a list of check groups to run (e.g. master, node, etcd, policies, controlplane).
